description: Round-trips a small public www.eventbrite.com URL (/api/v3/categories/) through the fetchproxy bridge and returns diagnostics: the bridge's role (host/peer/null), port, version, the extension link (linked / pair pending / not attached / never answered), the elapsed round-trip time, and a plain-English hint distinguishing 'bridge never came up' from 'extension not connected' from 'real www.eventbrite.com-side problem'. Read-only, no auth required. Call this when a real tool fails and you want to know which hop broke.
name: eb_healthcheck
title: Verify the fetchproxy bridge end-to-end
